summary: TIM S.A. filed a 6-K reporting its Fiscal Council's favorable opinion on a proposed distribution of Interest on Shareholders' Equity (IE) totaling R$400 million. The gross value per share is R$0.1674573219, with payment scheduled by July 22, 2026, to shareholders of record as of June 22, 2026 (ex-date June 23, 2026). A 17.5% withholding tax applies unless exempt. The gross per-share amount may adjust for treasury share variations. No board recommendation or advisor named. This is a capital return via IE, analogous to a dividend, not a special situation such as a tender offer or going-private. What to watch: actual payment date and any tax implications for foreign shareholders.
